summary: Genenta Science S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K to disclose a court order in a precautionary proceeding brought by minority shareholders. The Court of Milan denied suspension of a multiple voting rights resolution (which remains effective) but granted interim suspension of a resolution amending the corporate purpose due to overly broad language referencing the Italian Golden Power regime. The Company has appealed the suspension, with a hearing set for July 9, 2026. No transactions, prices, or business combinations are involved. This is an ordinary litigation disclosure with no special-situation event.
